fact: Amur leopards have thick coats that help them survive cold winters.
Javan rhinos have a single horn and live in dense tropical forest.
Sumatran rhinos are the smallest living rhinoceroses and are covered with sparse hair.
Black rhinos use a pointed upper lip to pull leaves and twigs from plants.
White rhinos have broad square lips that are well suited for grazing on grass.
African forest elephants have straighter tusks and rounder ears than savanna elephants.
African savanna elephants are the largest land animals alive today.
Asian elephants have smaller ears than African elephants and a single finger-like tip on the trunk.
Sumatran elephants live on the Indonesian island of Sumatra.
Mountain gorillas have thick fur that helps keep them warm in cool mountain forests.
Cross River gorillas live in forested mountains along the Nigeria-Cameroon border.

Sumatran orangutans build leafy sleeping nests high in trees.
Tapanuli orangutans live in a small forest region on the island of Sumatra.
Bonobos live only in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and are closely related to chimpanzees.
Chimpanzees can use sticks and other simple tools to find food.
Golden lion tamarins have bright golden-orange fur and live in Brazil's Atlantic Forest.
Cotton-top tamarins have a distinctive crest of long white hair on their heads.
Philippine tarsiers have huge eyes that help them hunt insects at night.
Red pandas use bushy tails for balance and to help keep warm.
Giant pandas use strong jaws and wrist bones adapted like thumbs to hold bamboo.
Snow leopards have long thick tails that help them balance on steep rocky slopes.

Sumatran tigers are smaller than many mainland tiger populations and live on Sumatra.
Malayan tigers live in tropical forests on the Malay Peninsula.
Iberian lynx have tufted ears and mainly hunt rabbits.
Ethiopian wolves live in high mountain grasslands and often hunt small rodents.
African wild dogs have unique patchy coats and live in highly social packs.
Dholes are social wild dogs from Asia that communicate with whistles.
Addax are desert antelope with twisted horns and broad hooves for walking on sand.
Saiga antelope have unusual flexible noses that help filter dust and warm cold air.
Przewalski's horses have stocky bodies and upright dark manes.
Grevy's zebras have narrow stripes and large rounded ears.
Okapis have striped legs and are close relatives of giraffes.
Pygmy hippos are smaller forest-dwelling relatives of common hippos.
Wild Bactrian camels have two humps and can survive extreme desert conditions.
Asian tapirs have a bold black-and-white body pattern and a short flexible snout.
Malayan pangolins are covered in protective scales and curl into a ball when threatened.
Chinese pangolins use long sticky tongues to collect ants and termites.
African penguins make braying calls that can sound a little like donkeys.
Yellow-eyed penguins have pale yellow eyes and a yellow band of feathers around the head.
Kakapos are heavy flightless parrots that are active mostly at night.
California condors have enormous wings that help them soar for long distances.
Philippine eagles have powerful feet and a shaggy crest of feathers.
Whooping cranes are tall white birds with long legs and long necks.
Spoon-billed sandpipers have small bills with spoon-shaped tips.

Leatherbacks are the largest sea turtles and have flexible leathery shells.
Vaquitas are small porpoises with dark markings around their eyes and mouths.
North Atlantic right whales have rough white patches called callosities on their heads.
Blue whales are the largest animals known to have lived on Earth.
Whale sharks are huge filter-feeding sharks with spotted skin.
Great hammerhead sharks have wide hammer-shaped heads that hold their eyes far apart.
Sawfish have long flat snouts edged with tooth-like structures.
Wild axolotls are salamanders that keep feathery external gills throughout life.
Chinese giant salamanders are among the largest amphibians in the world.
Gharials have very long narrow snouts adapted for catching fish.
Siamese crocodiles are freshwater crocodiles from Southeast Asia.
